houses = [1, 2, 3]

solver.add(Distinct(smoothie_vars.values()))

solver.add(Distinct(height_vars.values()))

solver.add(And(height_vars[house] == heights.index("very short"), book_genre_vars[house] == book_genres.index("romance")) for house in houses)

solver.add(And(book_genre_vars[house] == book_genres.index("mystery"), birthday_vars[house] == birthdays.index("sept")) for house in houses)

solver.add(And(height_vars[house] == heights.index("average"), smoothie_vars[house] == smoothies.index("desert")) for house in houses)

# 7. Eric is in the first house.

# 8. The Watermelon smoothie lover is the person who is short.

    solution = {
        "solution": {

    for house in houses:
